verdict.rationale: The Open Finance REST API covers the core operations an agent would call. It retrieves balances (docs-2) and transactions (docs-7, docs-32), links accounts via Connect (docs-27), and authenticates with Partner ID, secret and appKey tokens (docs-10, docs-23). However, the official MCP server is a developer-assist toolkit for code generation and documentation Q&A (docs-12, docs-34), not an operational surface for performing actions. Credentials appear to be partner-wide rather than scoped. Missing for 10: an operational MCP surface that executes balance, transaction and connection calls; scoped or least-privilege agent credentials; explicit documentation of creating Connect link sessions and managing or deleting connections; independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
